channel.title: Rahul Prajapati
channel.description: Hands-on posts on Google Cloud, GKE, Terraform and platform engineering.

item.title: Tool-level auth and tracing for MCP traffic with an agent gateway
item.description: An API gateway sees every MCP tool call as one POST /mcp. How an agent gateway adds per-agent identity, tool allowlists, rate limits and tracing.

item.title: Give an AI agent gcloud, kubectl and Terraform without the keys
item.description: Threat model for AI agents with gcloud, kubectl and Terraform: read-only identities, dry-run limits, approval gates and audit logs per tool call.

item.title: Debug Cloud NAT port exhaustion behind a Kong gateway on GKE
item.description: Spot Cloud NAT port exhaustion behind Kong on GKE in logs and metrics, pick DPA or min ports, handle EIM, and size NAT before a traffic campaign.

item.title: Replace service account JSON keys with Workload Identity on GKE
item.description: Move GKE workloads from JSON keys to Workload Identity: why ADC keeps using the key, the IAM binding people skip, and how to verify a token from the pod.
